label: 筒帽兜
summary: a stiff banded drum under a soft cone with the bent tip; set down, the drum keeps a flat floor with upright walls and the soft tip folds into a pouch at the bow that holds the stores

hook.note: set down, the bent tip lies folded flat inside the pouch's bottom cloth

afloat.note: hat units: the drum stays upright (its floor is the drum's top), the cone's lower part lies flat on that floor, and from pocket_from of its height the cone and tip make a round pouch under the floor, its centre this far toward the bow
